intro: Weazel's Crater is a deep gouge carved into the hard salt of the northern Shimmering Flats. Its origins are mysterious, and Saltstone basilisks inhabit the hollow.

p: Across the blinding white expanse of the Shimmering Flats, experimental goblin and gnome rocket-cars constantly push the boundaries of mechanical sanity. Debris, scorched earth, and impact hollows litter the plains, but Weazel's Crater stands out for its sheer size and depth. The crater's origins are unknown. Today, the mechanical wreckage has largely settled, and the hollow has been claimed as a sunning pit by aggressive Saltstone basilisks.
